title.en: MALACANANG BY THE PRESIDENT OF THE PHILIPPINES AND DELINEATING THE MAS BATE PORT ZONE UNDER ADMINISTRATIVE JURISDICTION PHILIPPINE PORTS AUTHORITY

text.en:
The Masbate Port Zone, as expanded,
is hereby placed under
the administrative
jurisdiction
of the Philippine
Ports Authority
which shall,
consistent
with the regional industrial
plans of the Government,
for the proper zoning, planning
development
and utilization
IN REPLYING.
,()
--~-
,'\. "

All other orders, proclamations
and issuances or portions
inconsistent
with this Executive
Order are hereby repealed or
modified accordingly.
This Executive Order shall take effect immediately.
DONE in the City of Manila, this 18~
of Our Lord, Nineteen Hundred and Ninety-Six.
